feature_contract.goal: Keep main-menu and vehicle-select native-aspect content entirely in a common physical OpenXR binocular view under asymmetric eye fields of view without stretching, lost selection columns, or newly altered desktop aspect handling.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the R84 OpenXR host's shared LOCAL-fixed menu projection tangent extents, corresponding common angular projection, and the existing menu geometry regression. Preserve original native 4:3/16:9/21:9 crop, World draws, HUD/GOAL/flare, R26_SAFE, DirectInput FFB, SkyGlow and DXVK freeze.
trace_stages: Original game produces menu and vehicle-selection sprites into the R84 D3D9Ex 2D source surface with native aspect and content crop.
R23 host PlanCommonFovTangents previously averaged independent left/right and up/down eye boundaries; the average can lie outside one eye's true view and clip menu/vehicle selection pixels.

The R23 common menu quad and per-eye OpenXR angular projection now use the intersection of tangent-space eye frusta, rejecting disjoint or malformed pairs and falling back to the established mono path.
subcomponents: Compute common horizontal and vertical tangent bounds by intersection, not arithmetic mean, before forming the same binocular raster projection.

Keep conversion to angular XrFovf synchronized to that intersected tangent projection and preserve the existing native-aspect crop, fallback when overlap degenerates, and unchanged R26_SAFE game route.
Cover symmetric and independently asymmetric horizontal/vertical eye pairs, disjoint eye frusta, and four destructive extrema mutations in the exact renderer menu-aspect verifier.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Source code at material SHA shows two eye tangent extremes were averaged in PlanCommonFovTangents despite one shared physical local-fixed menu quad; intersection is the necessary common visible tangent range.
source_trace: Game menu sprites are captured in source dimensions and native crop.
R23 PlanCommonFovTangents computes shared local-fixed projection for eye pair.
OpenXR host uses atan(common edges) for menu projection and the R84 host submits it to both eyes.
diagnosis.root_cause: Arithmetic mean of eye FOV tangent edges can exceed either eye's frustum on opposite sides, cropping native menu or car selector despite a mathematically centered shared quad.
alternatives_rejected: Mean XrFovf angles are not valid tangent-space projection bounds and do not ensure binocular intersection.
Expanding raster or changing game HUD/native source crop cannot repair the common projection exceeding one eye's real FOV.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Original material SHA 5577a923 implements max(left/down) and min(right/up) with overlap guard, preserves atan conversion and the old mono fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: tools/verify_vr_menu_letterbox_aspect.py adds symmetric/asymmetric/disjoint and four destructive extrema mutations; pending final exact-SHA Actions.
